# FLX-5034: a parameter the declared property needs is absent

**Family:** numerics (the 5000 band)

SEAM-FIDELITY-SPEC §2: every property's parameters are present, and a contract missing any of them is refused before any statistic is formed. A histogram needs bins, a quantile needs a level, every property needs a tolerance of the type its comparison uses, and every column a property names needs its own declaration in columns.

## Look it up offline

```console
$ fluxsim explain FLX-5034
```

Every code is listed in the [error index](./README.md).
